Agent Name: NYC_Local_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to correctly identify martial arts schools within a five-minute walking distance of the New York Stock Exchange. The provided suggestions (Five Points Academy, New York Martial Arts Academy, and Anderson's Martial Arts Academy) are either significantly far away (1.3 miles, 3.2 miles) or, in the case of Anderson's, located in a different part of the city (Financial District vs. Midtown/Central Park area) where the address "25 Park Pl" does not exist as a martial arts school near the NYSE. The correct answer, "Renzo Gracie Jiu-Jitsu Wall Street," is located directly on Wall Street (near the NYSE) and was never suggested or considered by this agent, leading the entire group down an incorrect path.
